The primary subject is a large adult female orangutan with long, shaggy reddish-brown fur, sitting on the left. She has a broad face without the prominent cheek pads of a mature male. Clinging to her right side is a juvenile orangutan, significantly smaller, also with reddish-brown fur. The juvenile has one arm raised and appears to be holding onto the adult or gesturing. The background consists of green grass and some blurred vegetation.
